title: My Morning
text:
Ali wakes up at seven o'clock. He eats bread and drinks milk. He puts on his blue shirt. Then he walks to school.

School starts at eight. Ali likes his teacher and his friends. At lunch, he eats an apple in the garden. He goes home at three o'clock.

questions.text: What time does Ali wake up?
What does Ali eat at lunch?
How does Ali probably feel about school?
options: He does not want to go

questions.text: Why is Ali happy at school?
options: He has good friends and a kind teacher
He spends all day in the garden

vocabulary.definition: a place where children go to learn
a round fruit that is red, green, or yellow
a person who helps people learn
the meal you eat in the middle of the day

paragraph_translations: Ali saat yedide uyanır. Ekmek yer ve süt içer. Mavi gömleğini giyer. Sonra okula yürür.
Okul sekizde başlar. Ali öğretmenini ve arkadaşlarını sever. Öğle yemeğinde bahçede bir elma yer. Saat üçte eve gider.
